questions.stem: A 78-year-old woman presents with exertional dyspnea, and chest pain. Echo was done and showed severe aortic stenosis, He has hypertension, chronic kidney disease (stage G4), hyperlipidemia, severe COPD, and atrial fibrillation. What is the most appropriate next step in treatment?
